$comment: plan 0070 D1.5 — the shape a test lane's result must hold. files carries content the wrapper commits (ADR-0006 §2); gaps is an output, not a failure (ADR-0006 §4); notes is free-form commentary the wrapper folds into the PR body. additionalProperties is false at every level on purpose: a vendor field this schema does not name is not silently forwarded into a commit or a PR body.

path.$comment: relative, confined under tests/ — bin/fleet-lane enforces this; the schema only asks for a non-empty string

executable.$comment: true refuses the whole result (plan 0070 D1.6) — content always lands mode 0644
